title: 摩根大通财富规划主管：管着1.4万亿美元，却靠心理学和法学？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I'm Barry Rittultz. You're listening to Masters in Business on Bloomberg Radio. My extra special guest this week is Adam Frank. He is the head of Wealth Planning and Advice at JP Morgan.
segments.zh: 我是巴里·里图尔茨。您正在收听彭博电台的《商业大师》。本周特邀嘉宾是亚当·弗兰克，他是摩根大通财富规划与咨询主管。

segments.en: Previously he held the same job at Bear Stearns before JP Morgan acquired them. The group manages about $1.4 trillion in specializes in sophisticated family business and succession planning.
segments.zh: 此前他在贝尔斯登担任同一职位，直到摩根大通收购该公司。该团队管理约1.4万亿美元资产，专精于复杂的家族企业和传承规划。

segments.en: The state-and-gift tax management, philanthropy, state litigation, taxation and employee stock
segments.zh: 涉及赠与税管理、慈善事业、州诉讼、税务和员工权益资产分析。

segments.en: option analysis, JP Morgan's combined asset and wealth management business, including global institutional private bank and retail is over $7 trillion. From Frank, welcome to Bloomberg.
segments.zh: 摩根大通合并后的资产与财富管理业务，包括全球机构、私人银行和零售业务，总规模超过7万亿美元。弗兰克，欢迎来到彭博。

segments.en: Barry, thanks. It's great to be here. It's great to have you. That was a mouthful to get out.
segments.zh: 巴里，谢谢。很高兴来到这里。很高兴邀请你。刚才那段话可真拗口。

segments.en: $3.00 will get you on the subway. Before we delve into what you do at JP Morgan, let's talk about
segments.zh: 3美元就能坐地铁。在我们深入了解你在摩根大通的工作之前，先聊聊

segments.en: your background because it's really very, very interesting. You earn a bachelor's in psychology at University of Pennsylvania. Then at JD at Yale, I'm guessing the original plan wasn't wealth management.
segments.zh: 你的背景，因为真的非常有趣。你在宾夕法尼亚大学获得心理学学士学位，然后在耶鲁获得法学博士。我猜最初的计划不是财富管理。

segments.en: It was not. The original plan was practicing law because it was either that or being a doctor.
segments.zh: 确实不是。最初的计划是当律师，因为要么做律师，要么当医生。
